data.description: 阳光灿烂的夏日沙滩上，和纱换上了别致的黑色比基尼泳装与可爱的猫耳遮阳帽，手里举着双球薄荷巧克力冰淇淋。黑发在海风中轻扬，粉瞳在粼粼波光下闪闪发亮——「这可是好不容易排队买到的限定冰淇淋！老师要是想吃的话……就乖乖陪我坐在遮阳伞下吃完再走。」
data.promptProse: Standing near the sunlit waterline of a bright summer beach in her black red-ribbon bikini and cat-ear swim hood, Kazusa holds up a double-scoop mint-chocolate ice cream cone in one hand. Glancing toward the viewer with a faint embarrassed blush as warm sea breeze lifts her short hair, she gestures toward a shaded beach umbrella nearby. Sparkling summer sunlight glints across the turquoise ocean waves and pale sand behind her.
data.title: 杏山和纱 · 夏日海滩·猫耳泳装与冰淇淋
data.animaCaption: Standing beside the sunlit summer surf in her black bikini and cat-ear swim hood, Kazusa holds a double-scoop mint-chocolate ice cream cone and glances at the viewer with a slight blush. Bright midday sun sparkles over the blue sea and nearby beach umbrella.
